doc: arch.md 3.16/6.2: one run = H* (8141 full) for its months, then I* on the chosen branch. Each step is sampled at points_per_step months; schedules interpolate piecewise-linearly by month. Months are never simulated: a point is a 12-slot snapshot.

points_per_step.reason: arch.md default; identical points are cached by spec_hash

start.source: data/phase2b/regret2.py:76-77 TIMELINES 'user (EVM to late 2027, H* to mid 2028, I* 30 months)' = months (3, 10, 7, 30) of E0@7623, E0@7976, H*, I* (EVM phases 3 + 10 months from 2026-11 -> H* late 2027); PHASE4-NETSIM.md section 2 'late 2027'
start.reason: H* has no date: Hegota is not scheduled on mainnet (spec.md T2)

months.source: data/phase2b/regret2.py:76-77 TIMELINES 'user (EVM to late 2027, H* to mid 2028, I* 30 months)' = months (3, 10, 7, 30) of E0@7623, E0@7976, H*, I*
months.reason: the campaign's 'user' timeline: H* to mid 2028

gas_limit.source: spec.md T10, T11 (EIP-8037 expects 100 M -> 300 M over a year); task brief 2026-11-12: 200 M default at H* and I*
gas_limit.reason: 60 M = today (59.88 M [M]) as the no-growth floor; 300 M = EIP-8037's end point

pq_share.unit: share of offered txs signed with leanSPHINCS
pq_share.source: no data (no PQ wallet in production)
pq_share.reason: emergency migration: early movers (exchanges, treasuries) first; 2 % at activation rising to 10 % over the step; run 0.01 and 1.0 as sensitivities

demand_tps.reason: total offered tx/s (ECDSA background + PQ), before the diurnal factor; today's included rate 23.04 tx/s [M] grown 10 %/yr; growth rate has no source (the gas limit triples, so price-elastic demand may grow faster: run x2)

slot_ms.note: 10 s if EIP-8198 lands (Considered for Hegota); 6 s (EIP-7782) is unscheduled and only a stress option

mix.unit: share of PQ txs; k signatures per multisig tx
mix.source: no measurement of k-of-n multisig share of txs; ERC-4337 EntryPoint calls are 1.7 % of txs (network_params traffic_baseline.erc4337_share [M])
mix.reason: a small multisig share (Safe-style 2-of-3, the common treasury setup) so k=2 shapes are exercised; 8141 rule 6 caps P99r at k <= 2 (spec.md A9), and FOCIL ILs hold no k >= 2 tx (A14)
